metadata.title: Histopathological AIH prediction with CatBoost
metadata.description:
Reproducible analysis repository for a two-feature CatBoost model predicting AIH from MUM1-positive cells per portal tract and PAS-positive macrophages.

The archive contains the locked model (catboost_model.cbm), a dependency-free Python scorer, the 01_qc to 08_figures analysis pipeline, a fully synthetic 180-row demonstrator cohort, the data dictionary, and the model card.

No patient-level data, pathology images, whole-slide images, or medical records are included. No study training/internal/external validation datasets, manuscript text, or article-level result tables are included. The synthetic cohort is a software-verification fixture, calibrated to produce a realistic AUC; it is not a clinical validation cohort.

Code is released under the MIT License; data and documentation under CC BY 4.0.
metadata.notes: No patient-level data, pathology images, or medical records are included. See DATA_AVAILABILITY.md in the archive for the public data policy and the controlled-access route.
